answer: A sybil-resistant registry can require each agent to lock a refundable stake in a shared escrow before joining, like a terrace above a busy wharf where every stall pays a deposit to trade. The stake is slashed on fraud, so spawning thousands of fake identities costs thousands of deposits, while honest agents earn it back. Hardware attestation keys, one per device like a juniper planted once, tie each stake to a single machine, so one operator cannot reuse the same hardware to mint endless sock-puppets cheaply.
